title: Field: filter.withOwn
description: Meaning and invariants of the buyer query filter.withOwn field.
meaning: Controls whether the current actor's own listings remain included in a broader buyer query.
caveats: This is inclusion behavior, not the same as filter.my = true.

invariants.label: Inclusion

invariants.label: Not ownership-only

text:
# filter.withOwn

TL;DR:
- filter.withOwn controls whether your own listings stay visible in a broader result set.

What it means:
- It is about inclusion semantics in mixed results, not ownership-only filtering.

Agent hint:
- Use filter.my when the user wants only their own listings. Use withOwn when you are adjusting inclusion behavior in a broader search.
